notes.title: Public Build: 0.756.9
notes.notes:
Since I have started working on a rewrite/redesign of the UI, I decided to quickly release the current build to the public.

The UI redesign is something I have been putting off for years, and it has started to interfere with development. Not to mention, the UI has been the target for complaints from players. The new design will make the game much less annoying, as well as open up development opportunities for me.
